text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — RetainerCo just crossed the safety-net threshold for their monthly credits. Saw the credit alert at 06:12 PT, they're at ~82% of committed credits with 9 days left. Need a quick spend forecast and an ask list for the QBR.
Luca Hernandez: On it. Pulling last 30 days now, will break down embeddings vs generation. ETA 15m.
Arjun Singh: If embeddings are the culprit we can suggest batching + caching. Can you also confirm whether they use dedicated endpoints or hosted?
Maya Patel: Hosted. They have two heavy routes: /chat (low-temp gen) and /embeds/bulk.
Priya Gomez: Tagging enablement — we should prep a short playbook for client engs: token limits, retry strategy, and cost-friendly batch samples.
alerts-bot: [ALERT] credits_throttle triggered for account=retainerco environment=prod threshold=0.8 current=0.82
Luca Hernandez: Quick snapshot: last 7d daily average tokens = 18M, 30d avg = 13M. Embeddings are ~62% of total token consumption. Predicting ~240M tokens for the month if pattern holds — exceeds committed 200M.
Maya Patel: Oof. Do we have per-route per-day peaks? Need to know if one export job is spiking.
Arjun Singh: Found a ~120M token bulk embed job on day -2 from ip 52.14. It's labeled "retainer-batch-v2" in metadata. Likely a nightly refresh they recently turned on.
Priya Gomez: Action items for QBR: 1) recommend throttling that batch to 20/min with a backoff; 2) show cost delta for moving to quantized embed model (x2 cost savings); 3) propose a short-term credits top-up or one-time retainer increase.
Luca Hernandez: Draft numbers for the deck: conservative forecast (with throttling) = 180M tokens (below commit). No-change forecast = 260M tokens (over by 60M). Cost impact: ~+$3.6k for the overage at current rates.
Maya Patel: Good. Can you sketch a 2-slide appendix: "Immediate mitigations" + "QBR ask" so we can share with customer before the meeting?
Arjun Singh: Also include a small config snippet clients can apply to their job scheduler to rate-limit. Example:
```bash
# rate limit embed batches to 20/min
export EMBED_BATCH_LIMIT=20
python run_batch.py --max-batches $EMBED_BATCH_LIMIT
```
Luca Hernandez: I'll add a chart and the dollar numbers. Priya — want me to include a recommended wording for the retainer/top-up ask?
Priya Gomez: Yes, one paragraph, empathetic tone, show tradeoffs. Offer a 2-week grace period and a remediation plan.
Maya Patel: I'll ping the CSM lead and schedule a quick pre-QBR sync with client engs after we have the slides. Thanks team.
alerts-bot: [NOTE] set a transient alert for next 72h: notify #customer-success if account consumption > 0.85 of commit
Luca Hernandez: Added the transient alert and shared the draft deck in drive at https://redwood.app/drive/retainerco-qbr-draft
Maya Patel: Perfect. We'll reconvene at 10:30 PT for final review.
Priya Gomez: I'll draft the customer email and share in the thread before the review.
Arjun Singh: Leaving a quick suggestion in the deck: trial a quantized embed endpoint (model: embed-q4o-v1) with a canary run of 5% traffic.
Maya Patel: Love it. Closing loop after review.
